stem: Which is the world's deepest trench?
expl: Challenger Trench is located in the Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands in the shape of a crescent. It has the deepest part of the Earth's oceans known as Challenger-Deep in Mariana Trench, named after the British exploration vessel HMS Challenger.

stem: Which one of the following is the deepest oceanic trench?
expl: Challenger Trench is located in the Pacific Ocean, east of the Mariana Islands in the shape of a crescent. It has the deepest part of the Earth's oceans known as Challenger-Deep in Mariana Trench, named after the British exploration vessel HMS Challenger.

stem: In which one of the following oceans Diamantina Trench is situated ?
expl: Diamantina Trench is in the Indian Ocean. It is located about 1125 km south-west of the Perth Basin. It is also known as Diamantina Fracture Zone.

expl: Sunda Trench is a deep submarine depression in the eastern Indian Ocean that extends some 2,000 miles (3,200 km) in a northwest-southeast arc along the southwestern and southern Indonesian archipelago. It is located about 190 miles (305 km) off the southwestern coasts of the islands of Sumatra and Java, stretching eastward south of the western Lesser Sunda Islands.
